name: Skills analysis generates real radar chart scores from existing CV
description: A logged-in user with an existing CV navigates to the Skills Analysis page, triggers analysis using their existing CV, and verifies real AI-generated scores appear on the radar chart along with an insight message - not static placeholder data.

planSteps.description: Enter testsprite@gmail.com in the email field
Wait for dashboard to load and click the Skills Analysis link in the sidebar
If 'Yeniden Analiz Et' button is visible, click it to show the upload/select screen.
Click the button to analyze with existing CV
Verify the AI insight card contains text describing the user's strengths and weaknesses
Verify the Radar Chart is displayed with actual scores
